coordinates.root: Body centred, X right in front view, Y up, Z front; millimetres. Top/bottom seam positions are X; left/right are Y. No Z-depth extent inferred from these photos.
coordinates.source: Original image x right, y down; inclusive integer pixel bands. Video frames are zero-based at24fps, decoded at native2880x1200.
coordinates.formula_side: Y=H/2-(p-p_top)/(p_bottom-p_top)*H. For horizontal video the source p is image x.
coordinates.uncertainty: Bounds picks approximately +/-2px (video) and +/-2-3px (photos), plus fit/projection/material-edge uncertainty included in explicit mm ranges. These are provisional reference fits, not manufacturer CAD. Do not round uncertainties away.

front_mask.optical_observation: Measured surround contains a recessed dark circular optic and small cyan pupil/reflection. Outer mask must bound any parent-built layered optics; do not fill the entire mask with a uniformly bright or flat lens. Internal dimensions/depths are illustrative, not independently measured.
front_mask.limits: Near-frontal animation frame and Pro-labelled product asset, not SDK artifact or calibrated physical camera photo. Keep X0; small apparent cross-axis offset is within pose uncertainty.

rail_material_boundary.limits: Metal envelope includes reflections/rail roll and lower exposed side from pose. It is separate from black glass. Do not turn these projected widths into a uniform flat ledge, thicker OLED bezel, or a claimed .70mm engineering measurement. The dark interval between upper highlights is not independently separable into metal reflection versus glass from RGB alone; the reported envelope is a candidate metal/roll boundary span, not a count of bright pixels or guaranteed all-metal shelf.
